description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates the use of GLSurfaceView for OpenGL rendering. It sets up a GLSurfaceView, assigns a renderer, and manages its lifecycle methods.

classes.name: GLSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: An activity that demonstrates setting up and managing a GLSurfaceView for OpenGL ES rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, sets its renderer, and assigns it as the activity content.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume, resumes GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause, pauses GLSurfaceView rendering.
